title: WhiteLiquid
description: WhiteLiquid is a lightweight Minecraft 1.21.11 optimization modpack focused on maximum FPS, faster loading times, and ultra-smooth performance.
body:
WhiteLiquid

WhiteLiquid is a lightweight Minecraft optimization modpack focused on improving performance and responsiveness while keeping the experience simple and clean.

Features

- Performance-focused configuration for smoother gameplay.
- Faster loading times and reduced resource usage.
- Compatible with visual enhancement mods and shaders.
- Minimal and lightweight setup without unnecessary additions.
- Designed for Minecraft 1.21.11.

WhiteLiquid aims to provide a balanced experience for players who want better performance while maintaining vanilla-style gameplay. Actual performance improvements may vary depending on hardware and installed mods.
